table.name: course
table.purpose: A lookup table of courses (subjects) offered, each with a start date in May; referenced by course_arrange for scheduling/assignments.

Course.name: course_name
Course.description: Name of the course/subject (e.g. Math, History, Bible, French). One row per course.

Course_ID.name: course_id
Course_ID.description: Primary key identifying each course; referenced by course_arrange.Course_ID.

Staring_Date.name: starting_date
Staring_Date.description: Start date of the course, stored as text in 'D May' format (day of May only, no year). Column name is a misspelling of 'Starting_Date'.

table.name: course_arrange
table.purpose: Junction/assignment table linking a course, a grade level, and a teacher: each row records which teacher teaches a given course to a given grade (class arrangement).

Course_ID.name: Course_ID
Course_ID.description: Identifier of the course being arranged; references course.Course_ID (lookup labels: 2=Math, 4=History, 7=Sports, 8=French, 10=Music).

Grade.name: Grade
Grade.description: Grade level (school year) to which the course is taught; integer values 1-7.

Teacher_ID.name: Teacher_ID
Teacher_ID.description: Identifier of the teacher assigned to teach the course at that grade; references teacher.Teacher_ID.

table.name: teacher
table.purpose: A roster of teachers, one row per teacher, identified by a surrogate Teacher_ID and referenced by course_arrange (which assigns teachers to courses).

Age.name: age_years
Age.description: Teacher's age in years (stored as text but integer-valued, range 26-45).

Hometown.name: hometown
Hometown.description: Teacher's place of origin, given as UK administrative area names (urban districts / municipal boroughs, mostly around Bolton, England).

Teacher_ID.name: teacher_id
Teacher_ID.description: Surrogate primary key for the teacher; referenced by course_arrange.Teacher_ID to assign teachers to course arrangements.
